title: Sparkly bow tie
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- left wing of bow tie -->
  <polygon points='50,50 22,32 22,68' fill='#FF3B5C' stroke='#FF8FA3' stroke-width='2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- right wing of bow tie -->
  <polygon points='50,50 78,32 78,68' fill='#FF3B5C' stroke='#FF8FA3' stroke-width='2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- left wing highlight -->
  <polygon points='50,50 28,37 28,63' fill='#FF6B85' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- right wing highlight -->
  <polygon points='50,50 72,37 72,63' fill='#FF6B85' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- center knot -->
  <rect x='44' y='41' width='12' height='18' rx='4' fill='#FF2050' stroke='#FF8FA3' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- knot highlight -->
  <rect x='47' y='44' width='6' height='12' rx='2' fill='#FF6B85' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- sparkle top-left -->
  <g transform='translate(15,15)'>
    <line x1='0' y1='-6' x2='0' y2='6' stroke='#FFE94A' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-6' y1='0' x2='6' y2='0' stroke='#FFE94A' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-4' y1='-4' x2='4' y2='4' stroke='#FFE94A' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='4' y1='-4' x2='-4' y2='4' stroke='#FFE94A' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>
  <!-- sparkle top-right -->
  <g transform='translate(85,18)'>
    <line x1='0' y1='-5' x2='0' y2='5' stroke='#FFD700' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-5' y1='0' x2='5' y2='0' stroke='#FFD700' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-3' y1='-3' x2='3' y2='3' stroke='#FFD700' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='3' y1='-3' x2='-3' y2='3' stroke='#FFD700' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>
  <!-- sparkle bottom-left -->
  <g transform='translate(18,82)'>
    <line x1='0' y1='-5' x2='0' y2='5' stroke='#FFE94A' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-5' y1='0' x2='5' y2='0' stroke='#FFE94A' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>
  <!-- sparkle bottom-right -->
  <g transform='translate(82,85)'>
    <line x1='0' y1='-5' x2='0' y2='5' stroke='#FFD700' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-5' y1='0' x2='5' y2='0' stroke='#FFD700' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-3' y1='-3' x2='3' y2='3' stroke='#FFD700' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='3' y1='-3' x2='-3' y2='3' stroke='#FFD700' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>
  <!-- tiny sparkle dots -->
  <circle cx='8' cy='45' r='2' fill='#FFE94A'/>
  <circle cx='92' cy='50' r='2' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='88' r='2' fill='#FFE94A'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='12' r='2' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='10' r='1.5' fill='#FFE94A'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='90' r='1.5' fill='#FFD700'/>
</svg>
